code: g <- expand.grid(r = 1:31, c = 1:41) spot <- function(r0, c0, a = 1) a * exp(-((g$r - r0)^2 + (g$c - c0)^2) / (2 * (3 / 2.3548)^2)) pair <- function(sep) matrix(spot(16, 18) + spot(16, 18 + sep) + 0.05, 31, 41) x <- pair(3)                       # two sources 3 px apart, FWHM 3 px res <- mssr(x, fwhm = 3, amp = 2) res #> <mssr_result> intensity_weighted_structure #>   input 31 x 41 -> output 62 x 82 (amp 2, extent grid) #>   fwhm 3 px, order 1, kernel disk (half-size 3), mesh TRUE #>   engine mssr_r_rev3; zero fraction 0.633 #>   Not a quantitative intensity: measure on the original data. op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(0.5, 0.5, 2, 0.5)) show(x, "input"); show(as.matrix(res), "mssr(amp = 2)") par(op) range(mssr_coords(res)$col) #> [1]  0.75 41.25 res$transform$spacing #> row col  #> 0.5 0.5 mid_ratio <- function(sep) {   x <- pair(sep)   r <- mssr(x, fwhm = 3, amp = 2)   v <- as.matrix(r)   co <- mssr_coords(r)   row <- which.min(abs(co$row - 16))   at_input <- function(cc) stats::approx(1:41, x[16, ], cc)$y   at_mssr <- function(cc) stats::approx(co$col, v[row, ], cc)$y   c(input = at_input(18 + sep / 2) / at_input(18), mssr = at_mssr(18 + sep / 2) / at_mssr(18)) } round(rbind(`2.4 px` = mid_ratio(2.4), `2.6 px` = mid_ratio(2.6), `3 px` = mid_ratio(3)), 3) #>        input  mssr #> 2.4 px 1.086 1.235 #> 2.6 px 1.054 0.815 #> 3 px   0.968 0.255 peaks <- function(sep, amp = 2) {   r <- mssr(pair(sep), fwhm = 3, amp = amp)   co <- mssr_coords(r)   v <- as.matrix(r)[which.min(abs(co$row - 16)), ]   i <- which(diff(sign(diff(v))) == -2) + 1   co$col[i[v[i] > 0.05 * max(v)]] } list(`2.4 px` = peaks(2.4), `2.4 px, amp 4` = peaks(2.4, amp = 4), `2.6 px` = peaks(2.6)) #> $`2.4 px` #> [1] 19.75 #>  #> $`2.4 px, amp 4` #> [1] 18.625 19.625 #>  #> $`2.6 px` #> [1] 18.25 20.25

code: # Two point sources 3 pixels apart, blurred with FWHM 3 px. g <- expand.grid(r = 1:21, c = 1:25) spot <- function(r0, c0) exp(-((g$r - r0)^2 + (g$c - c0)^2) / (2 * (3 / 2.3548)^2)) x <- matrix(spot(11, 11) + spot(11, 14) + 0.05, 21, 25) res <- mssr(x, fwhm = 3, amp = 2) res #> <mssr_result> intensity_weighted_structure #>   input 21 x 25 -> output 42 x 50 (amp 2, extent grid) #>   fwhm 3 px, order 1, kernel disk (half-size 3), mesh TRUE #>   engine mssr_r_rev3; zero fraction 0.498 #>   Not a quantitative intensity: measure on the original data. dim(as.matrix(res)) #> [1] 42 50
